answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake locked for the epoch, and tie reputation to a single verified identity vertex in a trust graph: new identities start at zero trust and earn it only through attested work. A sybil swarm then faces a real cost, since every fake identity must fund its own stake, while honest agents pass through like boats at a jetty, checked once and waved on. A prism of independent attestors, not one gatekeeper, verifies the work, so forging many identities costs more than it can earn.
